description.value:
Effect: Choose a signature minion from a summoner's portfolio that shares a keyword with one of the creatures the summoner could summon. You can summon three of that minion into a single squad (up to a maximum of four creatures) at the start of each of your turns in combat. The distance you can command them is equal to your ranged free strike distance. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.draw-steel.rewards.Item.WAzv6xku3g4d4WBj]{Strike For Me} triggered action, which now has the Psionic keyword and loses the Magic keyword.

Additionally, you can summon up to two of your signature minion while outside of combat to do simple tasks.

prerequisites.value: You can't use the Call Forth ability, and you defeat a leader or solo creature with a Summon or Call Forth ability, such as a high elf ordinator.

system.story: When their leader fell, they started listening to me for some reason.
